headline: Hello, I'm Iqra,
a web designer & developer.
intro: I design everything myself in Figma and build it in Next.js, React and WordPress. A creative who codes.
spiral: IQRA FARAH · WEB DESIGNER & DEVELOPER · FIGMA TO PRODUCTION ·

title: Learning by shipping.
Every single time.
index.text: I'm creative, so I design. I'm technical, so I build. Everything starts as my own design in Figma and ends as a fast, working site, with automations on top when a business needs them. I'm full stack, strongest on the frontend, and I've shipped real sites for a scheduling tool, a restaurant and a law firm.
index.label: Projects shipped

experience.text: Managed and updated text, images and video on client websites, built WordPress websites, supported customers and built the Restaurant Gem website.
Solved IT-related issues, supported end users, brainstormed solutions and offered advice.

about.text: I'm Iqra Farah, a web designer and developer based in Noord-Brabant. I design everything myself in Figma, then build it in code, from the first sketch to the live site. I'm full stack with frontend as my strongest side, and I set up automations with n8n and GoHighLevel.
